scores.tell: Dock planks have fairly fine grain and soft gloss, close to real; water sparkle slightly busy and noisy.
Smooth glossy dome and matte stone/ground mix with soft stipple craters; very close, only slight plastic uniformity on the rings.
Dock wood is smooth with big flat orange faces and chunky bolt details; plank grain is faint, a bit uniform plastic.
Pumpkin has soft waxy sheen and subtle pores; glow and gloss fairly uniform, rim lighting a touch airbrushed.
Black locomotive body is uniformly glossy, like lacquered plastic, with few matte/metal contrasts; tiny bolts are chunky.
Same lacquered black engine with smooth sheen; plank and rail textures are soft but metal is not distinct from paint.
Rope twist ridges have soft gloss with fine highlights, smoothly stylized like the real towel and saddle; none significant.
UFO is slick glass-like plastic everywhere; teal body is a smooth gradient with no fine surface detail, and the dome gloss is a large hard highlight.
Gravestone is a flat matte clay-like blue-gray with no stone grain or chips; the crack is a thin drawn line and the surface is airbrushed smooth.
Marble tables have soft veining and matte finish, which fits; checker board and grass blades are a bit busy, with an AI smear in the marble.
